links.outcome: Clinician documentation time and effort after ambient scribe deployment
links.effect: 84% mean effort reduction in HPI and A&P sections among 1802 active clinicians; after-hours documentation down 8.9% and 16.6%; chart closure time down 25.3% and 39.3% across two cohorts.
links.quote: Among 1802 active clinicians, the platform delivered an 84% mean effort reduction in completion of history of present illness and assessment and plan note sections, with an average of 14.9 minutes of recording per encounter.

links.outcome: Patient experience survey scores for ambient versus non-ambient encounters
links.effect: Ambient AI encounters scored equivalent to or higher than non-ambient encounters across all domains on two survey instruments; within-provider differences were largely nonsignificant.
links.quote: Patient experience showed no evidence of harm.

unlisted_practices: voluntary clinician-centered adoption of ambient scribes
executive sponsorship and defined organizational purpose for ambient AI
EHR-native (Epic Signal) measurement of documentation burden
targeting ambient scribe support to the most documentation-burdened clinicians (floor-raising)

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment and clinical workflow impact of an enterprise-wide ambient AI scribe across ambulatory clinics, but does not compare specific guardrails or deployment practice variants against a control.
